summary: golang.org/x/text is reachable in this CLI, not merely required, so its vulnerability floor is a real gate rather than an advisory one.
reason: Two ordinary code paths pull golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm into the reachable set: cliutil.ProbeReachable closes an HTTP/3 response body, and store.UpsertBatch formats through fmt. That makes govulncheck's package-reachability scan fail the CLI on x/text advisories that most catalog entries can ignore. A regen must keep x/text at or above the current fixed version rather than accepting whatever the module graph resolves.
validated_outcome: GO-2026-5970 reported five reachable traces at x/text v0.37.0; govulncheck ./... reports no vulnerabilities at v0.39.0, with go build, go vet, and go test ./... all passing.
